About TA TRADING COMPANY

Complete Irrigation Solutions for Every Green Need

Based in Pathadipalam, Ernakulam, Kerala, TA TRADING COMPANY is a dedicated distributor of professional irrigation equipment, agricultural sprayers, and precision drip systems. We supply farmers, plantation managers, landscapers, and irrigation contractors with genuine, field-proven components at highly competitive wholesale rates.

Save Water

High efficiency nozzles and drip laterals deliver measured hydration with minimal wastage.

Healthy Crops

Uniform water distribution creates optimal soil moisture conditions for higher crop yields.

Cost Effective

Built with UV-stabilized virgin polymers and heavy brass to provide years of dependable service.

Complete Solutions

Full spectrum coverage from source to field: pumps, filters, mainline valves, down to micro drippers.
